shot.definition:
n. a solid missile discharged from a firearm
n. a chance to do something
n. a person who shoots (usually with respect to their ability to shoot)
n. an aggressive remark directed at a person like a missile and intended to have a telling effect
shot.translation:
n. 发射, 炮弹, 射击, 射手, 投篮, 射门, 子弹, 射程, 拍摄, 注射
vt. 装弹, 使成颗粒状
a. 杂色的, 交织着的, 渗透的, 点焊的, 破旧的
shoot的过去式和过去分词

shot clock.translation: n. 时限钟（进攻方在24秒内必须投篮, 并且球必须触及篮框, 否则即违例）

shot effect.translation:
散粒效应
[电] 散弹效应

shot glass.translation: 小酒杯(尤指饮用威士忌等烈性酒者)

shot noise.translation:
[计] 散射噪声
[化] 散粒噪声

shot up.translation: 喷出; 发芽; 急升

shot-silk reflex.translation: [医] 闪缎反射, 闪缎样视网膜

shotcrete.translation: [化] 压力喷浆; 喷射水泥砂浆

shotgun.definition: n. firearm that is a double-barreled smoothbore shoulder weapon for firing shot at short ranges
shotgun.translation:
n. 散弹猎枪, 媒人
v. 用猎枪射击

shotgun marriage.translation: n. （主美）强迫婚姻; 特指男方被迫与某一被自己损害了名声的女人结婚。; （主中国）拉郎配; 强拉男子与女子结婚奉子成婚

shotgun shell.translation: [网络] 散弹；猎枪弹；散弹枪弹药

shotgun wedding.translation: n. 强制婚姻, 勉强的妥协

shotgunner.translation:
n. 猎枪, 滑膛枪；盒式建筑物(两排房间夹走廊)
a. 猎枪的；滑膛枪的；用猎枪打的；猎枪使用的；滑膛枪用的
vt. 用猎枪打(或威胁、逼迫)：；[美国口语]逼迫, 胁迫：

shotguns.definition: n. firearm that is a double-barreled smoothbore shoulder weapon for firing shot at short ranges
shotguns.translation: n. （双管）猎枪( shotgun的复数形式 ); 霰弹枪; （因女方怀孕而）不得不举行的婚礼; 奉子成婚

shotholes.translation: 爆破孔, 弹孔[痕], 圆虫孔

shotmaking.translation: n. <美>[体]击[投]球,准确击[投]球,击[投]球成功率

shotokan.translation: 松涛馆（空手道的一个流派）

shots.definition:
n the act of firing a projectile
n a solid missile discharged from a firearm
n (sports) the act of swinging or striking at a ball with a club or racket or bat or cue or hand
n a chance to do something
n a person who shoots (usually with respect to their ability to shoot)
n a consecutive series of pictures that constitutes a unit of action in a film
n the act of putting a liquid into the body by means of a syringe
n a small drink of liquor
n an aggressive remark directed at a person like a missile and intended to have a telling effect
n an estimate based on little or no information
n an informal photograph; usually made with a small hand-held camera
n sports equipment consisting of a heavy metal ball used in the shot put
n an explosive charge used in blasting
n a blow hard enough to cause injury
n an attempt to score in a game
n informal words for any attempt or effort
n the launching of a missile or spacecraft to a specified destination
shots.translation: n. 炮弹；射击；射手（shot的复数）

shotted.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Shot
a. Loaded with shot.
a. Having a shot attached; as, a shotten suture.

shotten.definition:
of Shoot
n. Having ejected the spawn; as, a shotten herring.
n. Shot out of its socket; dislocated, as a bone.

shotting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Shot

shotton.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 肖顿住所名称，来源于古英语，含义是“苏格兰人的居留地”(settlement of the Scots)或“苏格兰人的山”(hill of the Scots); [地名] [英国] 肖顿

shotts.translation: (shott 的第三人称 -s形式) (北非)浅盐水湖

shotty.translation: a. 似弹丸般硬而圆的

shotty breast.translation: [医] 弹丸状乳腺, 席梅耳布施氏病(增生性乳腺炎)
